notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR21: for a USE procedure about to run, 'DEBUG-LINE identifies the statement that causes execution of the USE procedure' and DEBUG-CONTENTS 'USE PROCEDURE'. EmitRunUseBody sets the UseProcedure cause for a declarative id before the bounded dispatch, and DebugsUseProcedure makes each statement record its line. Probes: witness matches; d10 (sequential READ at end, relative READ invalid key 23, indexed duplicate WRITE 22, READ of a closed file 47, none with its phrase: USE PROCEDURE, DEBUG-LINE the I-O statement, the next statement runs; a paragraph subject in the USE section too); d9 (ALL PROCEDURES, failed OPEN INPUT 35: section and paragraph, DEBUG-LINE the OPEN); 2002/2023 COBOL0902.

next.reason: 1985: "DEBUG-CONTENTS contains 'USE PROCEDURE'."; 2023: "No candidate covers USE FOR DEBUGGING or DEBUG-ITEM; the Debug module is absent from 2023". No clause holds the Debug feature.
